If CVT hydraulic pressure learning is performed before G sensor 0 point learning, P1589/C1 is output; in that case, perform (*1), (*2) and (*3), (*4) to return to normal.
Be sure to place the vehicle on a level surface and perform 0 point learning.
Do not subject the vehicle to vibration while 0 point learning is in progress.

test1.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF, move the shift lever to the P position and apply the parking brake. (*1)
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select [Utility] from the main menu and select [Transmission] in the utility category.
Select [A/T/CVT Learned Value Initialization] on the screen to initialize the learned values.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select [Utility] from the TOP menu and select [Transmission] in the utility category. (*3)
Select [G Sensor 0 Point Learning Start] on the screen to perform G sensor 0 point learning. (*4)

item.ptxt: When [Complete] is displayed on the screen, G sensor 0 point learning is complete.
If [Error] is displayed on the screen and the check engine warning light illuminates, there may be a malfunction in the yaw rate sensor system.

If the vehicle is subjected to vibration during 0 point learning, 0 point learning may be canceled. (If [Error] is displayed on the screen and the check engine warning light does not illuminate) In that case, perform the work in (*4) again.

entry.ptxt: G sensor 0 point learning ended normally
Check engine warning light illuminates again

atten3.ptxt: Do not initialize the learned values.

test1.ptxt: Turn the IG OFF and wait for 30 seconds or more.
Move the shift lever to P.
Turn the IG ON (engine stopped) and wait for 2 seconds or more.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select [Utility] from the TOP menu and select [Transmission] in the utility category.
Start the engine and wait for 5 seconds or more.
Select [CVT Hydraulic Pressure Learning Start] on the screen to perform CVT hydraulic pressure learning.

item.ptxt: During CVT hydraulic pressure learning, the engine is in an idle-up state.
When [Complete] is displayed on the screen, hydraulic pressure learning is complete.
The CVT hydraulic pressure learned values are not initialized just by disconnecting the battery.

test1.ptxt: Check the yaw rate sensor installation condition and check that the sensor is not tilted, the bracket is not deformed, and the installation is not loose.
Using SST (TaSCAN), display the [ECU Data Monitor] screen according to the screen display, and check the computer data.

item.ptxt: Initializing the learned values clears both the G sensor 0-point learning values and the CVT hydraulic pressure learning values, so when replacing the parts in the table below, perform AT/CVT learned value initialization and be sure to perform both G sensor 0-point learning and CVT hydraulic pressure learning.
Continuously Variable Transaxle
Engine Control Computer
Skid control computer
Oil Pressure Sensor
Yaw Rate Sensor
After performing AT/CVT learned value initialization, be sure to perform G sensor 0-point learning first, and then CVT hydraulic pressure learning.
Be sure to place the vehicle on a level surface and perform 0 point learning.
Do not subject the vehicle to vibration while 0 point learning is in progress.

When replacing the skid control computer or the yaw rate sensor on vehicles with the Intelligent Parking Assist system, be sure to also perform G sensor 0 point writing for the Intelligent Parking Assist system.
